learning_outcomes.text: Learns the names and uses of technical tools found in professional literature.
Acquires the skill to ask and answer questions from a professional perspective.
Learns the laboratory use of professional devices.

syllabus_topics: Review and update of general English knowledge to form the basis for academic foreign language proficiency
Review and update of general English knowledge to form the basis for professional foreign language proficiency
Terms, words, and concepts frequently used in Electrical-Electronics Engineering
Hand tools used in basic Electrical-Electronics Engineering laboratories
Components used in advanced Electrical-Electronics Engineering laboratories
Circuit diagrams and symbols of components
Graphical representations of analog and digital signals
Phase angles and basic AC circuits
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course plan. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
bibliography: Oxford English for Electrical and Mechanical Engineering Eric H. Glendinning - Norman Glendinning
